analysis.crux: The whole dispute reduces to one question: whether the apartment damage is attributable to Alex rather than ordinary wear. That is the single fact the kernel cannot — and will not — decide for you. Everything else above follows from your answer to it.
dissolved: The $400.00-vs-$350.00 gap is a number to correct, not a deception: the items simply add up to $350.00.

genuine_conflicts.description: Whether the apartment damage is attributable to Alex rather than ordinary wear — a real disagreement of fact and judgment, not just different words.

ledger_findings: If the apartment damage is attributable to Alex rather than ordinary wear: the certified amount is $1150.00. If not: $1400.00.
The stated figure of $400.00 is not what the itemization supports — the items total $350.00.

  Living room rug → sam (whole)
